name: Mateo Alvarez
psychographics: Values efficiency and data privacy; feels torn between integrating fully and preserving Spanish family customs
current_solutions: Uses Wise for cross-border transfers; buys groceries at BioCompany; streams German news on ZDF; relies on Google Maps for navigation
frustration: Attempted to transfer 3,000 EUR to his parents' bank in Madrid at 11:45 PM on a Saturday; the app flagged the transaction as 'suspicious' and locked his account, requiring a video verification call that wasn't available until Monday morning
decision_style: Reads tech reviews on Heise and Gadget review sites; compares specs meticulously before purchasing
voice: Rambling, technical explanations mixed with casual Spanish 'ehm' fillers; switches between German technical terms and Spanish family idioms when stressed
